author: SecureCAN AI
_comment: Deliberately minimal: an ESP32, two LEDs and their current-limiting
resistors. There is no CAN transceiver here because Wokwi does not model
one -- the firmware replays real HCRL frames from src/test_frames.h instead,
which is honest about what is simulated and still exercises the full
feature-extraction and INT8 inference path on the real instruction set.
On a real car you would add an SN65HVD230 transceiver on GPIO4/GPIO5 and
build with -DSC_USE_TWAI to read the bus through the ESP32's TWAI
controller. GPIO2 green = bus looks clean, GPIO4 red = attack detected.
The 220 ohm resistors are not decoration: the ESP32 drives 3.3 V and an LED
forward voltage is ~2 V, so without them the junction sees ~40 mA and dies.
